definitions.explanation: Literary works from earlier eras regarded as having lasting value, especially the classical literature of Japan such as Heian-period works. May also refer to the classics of any country.

examples.japanese: {古典文学|こてんぶんがく}を{研究|けんきゅう}している。
{源氏物語|げんじものがたり}は{日本|にほん}の{古典文学|こてんぶんがく}の{代表作|だいひょうさく}だ。
examples.english: The Tale of Genji is a representative work of Japanese classical literature.

examples.japanese: {高校|こうこう}の{授業|じゅぎょう}で{古典文学|こてんぶんがく}に{触|ふ}れ、{昔|むかし}の{言葉|ことば}の{美|うつく}しさを{知|し}った。
examples.english: In high school classes I encountered classical literature and learned the beauty of the old language.

notes:
Compound of {古典|こてん} (classic, classical work) + {文学|ぶんがく} (literature).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {古典文学|こてんぶんがく}を{学|まな}ぶ: to study classical literature
- {日本|にほん}の{古典文学|こてんぶんがく}: Japanese classical literature
- {古典文学|こてんぶんがく}{作品|さくひん}: a work of classical literature

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {現代|げんだい}{文学|ぶんがく}: modern literature — the contrasting term for contemporary works
- {古文|こぶん}: classical Japanese — the old written language studied in school, not the body of literature itself
